ca_watergate_rock.blurb: A small dome standing by itself on the desert floor in the Comic Book area of central Joshua Tree, facing a couple of better-known formations. Its tilted northeast side carries eighteen single-pitch climbs, mostly gear-protected, with a few bolted lines and some top-rope setups. Expect friction slabs and thin face moves rather than cracks. Grades start around 5.6 and cluster between 5.8 and 5.10, with a handful of 5.11 and 5.12 lines for stronger climbers, so it suits a mixed group wanting short, technical routes.
ca_watergate_rock.approach: Take the main trail toward the Comic Book formation, then bear right onto the marked path that leads to the base. Allow roughly 15 to 20 minutes on foot from the car.

ca_5_manure_pile_buttress_aka_ranger_roc.blurb: A granite buttress on the north side of Yosemite Valley, just east of El Capitan and about 600 feet tall, with a parking area of its own close by. All 18 climbs are traditional and mostly fall between 5.8 and 5.10, with one harder 5.11 line and a few easier ones. It is a friendly, moderate place that draws steady traffic, so expect company on the better routes. Rock quality is uneven, with lichen and vegetation on some upper sections, and sun-baked slabs get warm in direct light. There is no water on the walk in, so bring your own.

ca_q_agony_arch_area.blurb: A compact, sunny section of the Riverside Quarry in the Inland Empire, sitting beside the 60 freeway at roughly 1,000 feet. Walls face south, so they catch sun from morning to evening and dry fast; the setting is sheltered from wind and carries traffic noise. Most of the 18 routes are short single pitches of around 50 to 70 feet, mainly sport, with a few trad and top-rope lines. A few climbs sit at 5.8 and 5.9, but the bulk are 5.11 and 5.12, with one 5.13, so it leans toward strong climbers. Bring water and sun protection.
ca_q_agony_arch_area.approach: From the main quarry formation, walk south along its base and round the corner to reach the wall; the trip is short and easy to follow.
